title: Amorphous material based heterostructures with disordered heterointerfaces for advanced rechargeable batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,1587-1611
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04566A, Review Article
Junwei Ding, Miao Du, Shiwen Wang, Linsen Zhang, Yuanzheng Yue, Morten M. Smedskjaer
The recent developments of amorphous material based heterostructures with disordered heterointerfaces for advanced rechargeable batteries are reviewed, focusing on the relation between material structure and electrochemical performance.
